info.title: GeoAttend API
info.description: Server-validated geofenced attendance and shift-scoped tracking. Mobile clients authenticate with Bearer tokens; the web dashboard uses httpOnly cookies plus an X-CSRF-Token header for state-changing requests. Client GPS readings are treated as untrusted evidence.
